$comment: Cube-face layout for multi-resolution tiles, shared by the Viewer (cube.ts) and every tile generator (Rust evx-media, demo facility). Camera looks down -Z, X right, Y up. A point on a face is forward + u*right + v*up, u and v in [-1, 1]; image row 0 is v = +1. Tile path: {basePath}/{face}/{level}/{row}_{col}.{format}. Never change: existing projects depend on it.
